li.a: Follow openjdk guidelines for throws clause alignment

subsection.name: Description
subsection.div:
Checks that the throws clause of a wrapped method or constructor declaration is properly aligned according to the
OpenJDK Java Style Guide.
subsection.p: This check only applies when the method or constructor declaration is wrapped, that is, the parameter list spans more than one line. Single-line declarations are not in scope.

ol.li: The throws keyword must start on a new line, it must not share the line with the closing ) of the parameter list.

The throws keyword must stand out from the parameter list by being indented 8 columns relative to either:
the column of the method/constructor declaration (i.e. the indentation of the line containing the declaration keyword)
the indentation (first non-whitespace column) of the source line immediately above the line where throws appears
